title: E2E.Test.PAR3.RAR5.Encrypted.Repair.Garnet.Spire.S01E06.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: A compressed three-volume RAR5 set with `-hp` header and data encryption, an external PAR3 set, and a damaged interior volume. PAR3 repairs ciphertext without the key; extraction with the password proves the restored bytes.
